questions: Airing on Fox from 1992 to 1999, this soap opera follows young adults living in a West Hollywood apartment complex and served as the second series in the Beverly Hills, 90210 franchise — which show?
Melrose Place: American prime-time soap opera (1992–1999)
Having joined the Italian resistance as a teenager in World War II, this journalist grew famous for fierce interviews with the likes of Henry Kissinger, Golda Meir, and the Shah of Iran — who is she?
Oriana Fallaci: Italian journalist and author (1929–2006)
In what year was Valtteri Bottas born?
Valtteri Bottas: Valtteri Viktor Bottas (Finnish pronunciation: [ˈʋɑltːeri ˈbotːɑs]; born 28 August 1989) is a Finnish racing driver who competes in Formula One for Cadillac.
This German painter mixes straw and lead into his canvases, drawing on Paul Celan's poetry to confront the Holocaust and German history — who is he?
Anselm Kiefer: German painter and sculptor (born 1945)
Honorary members of the Royal Academy

Affecting about half of all adults and often treated with antifungal cream, this common scalp condition causes flaking and mild itchiness but isn't actually caused by poor hygiene. What condition is it?
Dandruff: Skin condition of the scalp. It can result in social or self-esteem problems.
Blackstone Inc.: Peter George Peterson. Blackstone Inc. is an American alternative investment management company based in New York City.
Companies listed on the New York Stock Exchange
In what year was R.E.M. founded?
R.E.M.: In the early 1990s, other alternative rock acts such as Nirvana, the Pixies, and Pavement named R.E.M. as a pioneer of the genre.
Alternative rock groups from Georgia (U.S. state)
